The '''discord missile''' was a [[Missile/Legends|missile]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Description==
[[File:Trifighter_trio.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A trio of [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]] carrying discord missiles.]]
Launched by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droids]] and [[Droid tri-fighter/Legends|droid tri-fighters]], each missile contained up to twenty one [[Pistoeka sabotage droid/Legends|buzz droids]], which it could release near [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. It could outmaneuver and outrun most starfighters and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] point-defenses.

==History==
[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] managed to "outsmart" two of these missiles during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]] while on a mission to rescue the [[Supreme Chancellor]]. The missile had a powerful rocket engine and an array of maneuvering fins, allowing them to accelerate at over 10,000G. It is identified by its blue trail, leading to the nickname "Blue Streak". [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] fighter was attacked by buzz droids after two of these missiles released the droids during the battle over Coruscant.
